title: ROSHNI KI RAAH | Diwali Song 2026 🪔 The Path of Light (ÆTHER original)
description:
A thousand diyas, one path home. Roshni Ki Raah is a Diwali song for every lamp lit on a doorstep, every rangoli drawn at dawn, every family waiting for the lights to come on.

Play it for Diwali nights, Lakshmi puja, rangoli time and festive drives. Happy Diwali from ÆTHER.

Music: Roshni Ki Raah, an original song by ÆTHER (AI-assisted). Photos are free-licence files from Wikimedia Commons, credited below.
